title: Agent 21 — Bitcoin-native AI Agent | Secret Satoshis
description: Agent 21 is a Bitcoin-native AI agent that helps you understand Bitcoin and analyze the market with Secret Satoshis research and current market and on-chain data.

fundamentals.title: Learn the fundamentals
fundamentals.summary: Start with a simple question. Agent 21 answers in plain language and helps you understand Bitcoin from first principles.

outlook.title: Review the Secret Satoshis price outlook
outlook.summary: Ask about our Bitcoin price outlook and newsletter updates, and see how our view of the market is holding up against the latest data.

market.title: Analyze the market
market.summary: Explore market and on-chain data through charts, with explanations of the readings that matter to your question.

price.title: See the market's odds
price.summary: See Polymarket's odds of Bitcoin touching each price this year, with the volume and liquidity behind them.

blockchain.title: Explore the blockchain
blockchain.summary: Look up Bitcoin transactions, blocks, and addresses, and understand their details using data read directly from the blockchain.
